lines.en: label yukicamp1:
scene sky
I peer up at the sky through a break in the trees and find a moment of comfort in convincing myself I’m not surrounded when I know I really am.
lines.zh: 我透过树冠的缝隙仰望天空，在说服自己「我没有被包围」的过程中找到一丝安慰，尽管我清楚自己确实被包围了。

lines.en: That, too, is somewhat poetic. Yet less so than it would be to die in the same way that I was more symbolically killed many, {i}many{/i} years ago.
lines.zh: 这本身也挺有诗意的。但远不如以我{i}许多{/i}年前被象征性杀死时同样的方式死去来得诗意。

lines.en: There’s poetry in everything, though.
lines.zh: 不过，万事万物里都有诗意。

lines.en: That’s something I’ve believed forever.
lines.zh: 这是我一直以来都相信的事。

lines.en: But I often find myself wondering whether I believe that because it’s what’s real to me or because it’s what someone else made me see after peeling away the covers.
lines.zh: 但我常常在想，我之所以相信它，是因为它对我来说是真实的，还是因为有人在掀开被子之后让我看到了它。

lines.en: And I often find myself wondering if those two thoughts are mutually exclusive because there’s a fine line between reality and what’s really {i}real,{/i} you know?
lines.zh: 我也常常在想，这两种想法是不是互斥的，因为现实和真正{i}真实{/i}之间只有一线之隔，你懂吧？

lines.en: It’s interesting how deeply the people we look up to when we’re young are able to affect us, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 我们年轻时仰望的人，能对我们的影响深到这种地步，很有意思，不是吗？

lines.en: And how, despite all the adversity and turmoil in the face of those teachings, changing {i}at all{/i} when you get to my age seems nigh impossible.
lines.zh: 而且，尽管在那些教诲面前经历了那么多逆境与动荡，到了我这个年纪，想做出{i}任何{/i}改变似乎都近乎不可能。

lines.en: Ami’s still young. So, if I want to mold her world, I need to do it now.
lines.zh: Ami 还小。所以，如果我想塑造她的世界，就得趁现在。

lines.en: Because waiting any longer not only runs the risk of ill-preparing her for what surely awaits us in this infinite life of ours-
lines.zh: 因为再等下去，不仅有风险让她对我们这无限人生中必然等着她的一切准备不足——

lines.en: But runs the risk of turning her into an actual monster who will pry open my ribcage before ripping my heart out and swallowing it whole.
lines.zh: 还有风险把她变成一个真正的怪物，先撬开我的肋骨，再把我的心掏出来整个吞下去。

lines.en: Girls these days will do crazy things for sustenance, you know. Or perhaps even leisure if you want to make her out to be even worse than she actually is.
lines.zh: 现在的女孩为了生存会干出疯狂的事，你知道的。或者，如果你想把她想得比实际更坏，甚至是为了消遣。

lines.en: But I know the truth.
lines.zh: 但我知道真相。

lines.en: She’s just broken and in love. And the two of those things can easily drive us mad on their own.
lines.zh: 她只是破碎且坠入爱河。而这两样东西各自都足以轻易把我们逼疯。

lines.en: When they’re combined, though?...
lines.zh: 可当它们合在一起呢？……

lines.en: : Yo!
When they’re combined, there’s nothing that can stop the metamorphosis other than someone who exhibits the same symptoms.
lines.zh: 当它们合在一起，除了另一个表现出相同症状的人，没有任何东西能阻止这场蜕变。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive1

As much as I’d love to inform you of our proper diagnoses, I’m afraid there’s not a doctor in the world we could pay to make sense of how our insides look or how they communicate with and respond to one another.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想告诉你们我们正确的诊断结果，但恐怕这世上没有一个医生是我们可以花钱雇来弄明白我们的内脏长什么样、或者它们如何彼此交流与回应的。

lines.en: I just know that they do.
lines.zh: 我只知道它们会。

lines.en: So maybe that’s “love” working its magic again. Or maybe it’s just the worm.
lines.zh: 所以也许那是「爱」又在施展魔法了。或者也许只是那条虫子。

lines.en: Whatever it is, though- know this one thing for sure.
lines.zh: 不过不管是什么——有一件事你尽管确定。

lines.en: Our time is numbered.
lines.zh: 我们的时间已经进入倒计时了。

lines.en: This will almost certainly be fatal.
lines.zh: 这几乎注定是致命的。

lines.en: : Took you guys long enough. Been waitin’ here for like an hour already.
lines.zh: : 你们可真够慢的。我都在这儿等了差不多一小时了。

lines.en: : I’m surprised your bike even made it here. I kind of assumed you’d just be hiking or something.
lines.zh: : 我挺惊讶你的摩托居然开到了这儿。我还以为你会徒步什么的。

lines.en: : Nah, I just brought my crappy old one. Had to drag it through a few puddles on the way over, but it got here in one piece either way.
lines.zh: : 没，我骑了我那辆破旧的。路上还得拖着它过几个水坑，不过好歹是完整地到了。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive2
: Sensei, who is that? She looks...kind of familiar.
lines.zh: : Sensei，那是谁？她看起来……有点眼熟。

lines.en: : Yumi’s mom. You’ve probably seen her at Sara’s bar for one of the parties.
lines.zh: : Yumi 的妈妈。你大概在 Sara 的酒吧某次派对上见过她。

lines.en: : Call it by its proper name! My ancestors didn’t come up with such a great pun just for it to be ignored by someone with no sense of humor!
lines.zh: : 叫它正式的名字！我的祖先想出那么棒的谐音梗，可不是为了让一个没有幽默感的人无视的！

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive3
: I’m Yuki. Ami, right?
lines.zh: : 我是 Yuki。Ami，对吧？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Sorry. It’s...nice to meet you?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉。那个……很高兴认识你？

lines.en: : Likewise. Sorry if my daughter’s ever picked on you before. Which she probably has because she’s a fuckin’ bitch.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。如果我女儿以前欺负过你，我替她道歉。她大概欺负过，因为她就是个操蛋的婊子。

lines.en: : Are you staying the night, Yuki? We’re giving Sensei and Ami the second tent, which means the rest of us will have to get kind of close.
lines.zh: : 你要留下来过夜吗，Yuki？我们把第二顶帐篷给了 Sensei 和 Ami，意思是我们其余人得挤得比较近。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive4
: Wasn’t plannin’ on it, but now I definitely ain’t plannin’ on it. Y’all can enjoy your fuckin’ slumber party on your own. I’m just gonna head back and crash once it gets dark.
lines.zh: : 本来没这打算，不过现在我他妈更没这打算了。你们自己享受这场操蛋的睡衣派对吧。等天黑我就回去倒头睡。

lines.en: : Worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 试试也不亏。

lines.en: : Are you sure, Yuki? We don’t open back up until tomorrow night, so it’s not like you have anywhere to be unless you have a secret Yakuza boyfriend you haven’t told any of us about.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，Yuki？我们明天晚上才重新开门，所以你也没别的地方要去——除非你有个没跟我们任何人说过的黑道秘密男友。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive5
: Just because the only dude I’ve ever {i}been{/i} with was in the Yakuza doesn’t mean that’s my {i}type,{/i} you know. I can like normal dudes.
lines.zh: : 我唯一{i}在一起过{/i}的男人是黑道的，不代表那就是我的{i}菜{/i}，你知道的。我也可以喜欢普通男人。

lines.en: : So you have a normal boyfriend instead?
lines.zh: : 所以你有个普通男友？

lines.en: : Sure. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 对。是的。

lines.en: : What’s his name?! When can we meet him?!
lines.zh: : 他叫什么名字？！我们什么时候能见他？！

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive6
: It’s that guy right there. We got together for Yumi’s sake and he just finished movin’ into my place. Got a dog and everything, which means we’re basically a real family now.
lines.zh: : 就是那边那个家伙。我们为了 Yumi 才在一起的，他刚搬进我家。还养了条狗什么的，也就是说我们现在基本上是个真正的家庭了。

lines.en: : Please don’t make jokes like that in front of Ami or you’ll wind up waking up with fewer body parts than you’re accustomed to.
lines.zh: : 别在 Ami 面前开这种玩笑，不然你醒来时会发现自己少了几个习惯拥有的身体部位。

lines.en: : Damn, now I {i}definitely{/i} ain’t sleepin’ here.
lines.zh: : 操，现在我他妈{i}更{/i}不可能睡这儿了。

lines.en: scene black
A brief argument about my relationship status subsequently takes place, but I decide to black most of it out as I can tell it’s making Ami uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 随后发生了一场关于我感情状态的小小争论，但我决定把大部分屏蔽掉，因为我能看出这让 Ami 很不舒服。

lines.en: I can tell this entire {i}trip{/i} is making Ami uncomfortable. But it’s not like I didn’t expect that to happen. And, to be completely honest, I’m probably even {i}more{/i} uncomfortable than she is.
lines.zh: 我看得出来，整趟{i}旅程{/i}都让 Ami 很不舒服。不过这我早就料到了。而且说实话，我大概比她还{i}更{/i}不自在。

lines.en: if amifingered == True and sarasex == True and makisex == True and harukasex == True:
Like, I’m having sex with {i}all{/i} of these girls apart from Yuki and that could spiral into something {i}horrible{/i} pretty quickly if I say or do just one thing wrong.
lines.zh: 比如，我除了 Yuki 之外跟这些女孩{i}全都{/i}上过床，而只要我说错或做错一件事，事情就可能迅速演变成一场{i}灾难{/i}。

lines.en: if amifingered == False and sarasex == False and makisex == False and harukasex == False:
Like, every single one of these girls wants to fuck me except Yuki (maybe) and I’ve yet to touch {i}any{/i} of them, so I’m practically a sitting duck out here.
lines.zh: 比如，这些女孩里除了 Yuki（也许）之外每一个都想操我，而我{i}一个{/i}都还没碰过，所以在这片地方我基本就是个活靶子。

lines.en: But I don’t matter today — and that’s saying a lot as someone who’s practically the symbol of self-loathing narcissism.
lines.zh: 不过今天我不重要——对于一个几乎就是自我厌恶式自恋象征的人来说，这话说得可真够重的。

lines.en: I’ll just stick to my guns and try to not let anything put me on the back foot for the next twenty-four hours so I can focus more on Ami.
lines.zh: 我就坚持自己的立场，试着在接下来二十四小时里不让任何事让我陷入被动，好把注意力更多放在 Ami 身上。

lines.en: : So! Wanna go for a walk, big dog?
lines.zh: : 那么！想去走走吗，大狗？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive7
: Please never call me “big dog” again. I was quite literally just thinking about how I don’t want anything to put me on my back foot so I can focus on Ami.
lines.zh: : 请永远别再叫我「大狗」了。我刚才真的正在想，不要让任何事让我陷入被动，好把注意力放在 Ami 身上。

lines.en: : Then I’ve got {i}extra{/i} bad news for you since I’m going to kidnap her now.
lines.zh: : 那我还有个{i}更{/i}坏的消息给你——因为我现在要把她绑架走了。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive8
: Why is everything I don’t want to happen suddenly happening in very quick succession? Are even my inner monologues not safe anymore?
lines.zh: : 为什么所有我不想发生的事，突然都在非常短的时间里接连发生？连我的内心独白都不安全了吗？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive9
{b}lmaoooooooooo{/b}
lines.zh: {b}哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈{/b}

lines.en: Oh, come on.
lines.zh: 拜托，别吧。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive8
: You’re kidnapping me?
lines.zh: : 你要绑架我？

lines.en: : Yeah! Let’s go set up your tent while Maki and Haru-chan put the other one together. Then, after that, I can show you a trick that’ll help you get rid of those dark circles.
lines.zh: : 对！我们去把你的帐篷搭起来，Maki 和 Haru-chan 搭另一顶。然后，我可以教你一个能去掉黑眼圈的小技巧。

lines.en: : I don’t think-
lines.zh: : 我觉得——

lines.en: : We’ve got a long day ahead of us, Sensei. It’s probably best to just let Sara get all of her motherly energy out of the way now since {i}her{/i} daughter’s not here to serve as the outlet for that.
lines.zh: : 我们今天还长着呢，Sensei。最好现在就让 Sara 把她那股母性能量全发泄掉，反正{i}她{/i}女儿不在这儿充当那个出口。

lines.en: : Just not {i}that{/i} kind of motherly energy.
lines.zh: : 只是别是{i}那种{/i}母性能量。

lines.en: : No one said anything about {i}that{/i} kind of motherly energy, Maki.
lines.zh: : 没人提{i}那种{/i}母性能量啊，Maki。

lines.en: : But we were {i}all{/i} thinking it.
lines.zh: : 但我们{i}都{/i}在想。

lines.en: : We most certainly were not.
lines.zh: : 我们绝对没有。

lines.en: : I was.
lines.zh: : 我有。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive10
: You {i}were?{/i}
: See?
lines.zh: : 看吧？

lines.en: : I admit defeat. I have underestimated the depravity of this group. Which, in hindsight, was extremely foolish of me.
lines.zh: : 我认输。我低估了这群人的堕落程度。现在回想起来，这实在蠢得可以。

lines.en: if harukapredator == True:
And doubly foolish as she is essentially my sex-slave now and would suck me off in front of everyone here with just the snap of my fingers.
lines.zh: 而且是双倍的蠢，因为她现在基本就是我的性奴隶，只要我打个响指，她就能当着这里所有人的面给我口。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive11
: The fuck’s even goin’ on right now?
lines.zh: : 这他妈到底在搞什么啊？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Yuki. If Maki keeps talking, her words will sully your status as the most innocent woman here.
lines.zh: : 别管了，Yuki。要是 Maki 继续说下去，她的话会玷污你作为在场最纯洁女性的地位。

lines.en: : There’s a friggin’ teenager here. Ain’t no way I’m more “innocent” than her.
lines.zh: : 这儿还有个操蛋的青少年呢。我不可能比她还「纯洁」。

lines.en: If only she knew.
lines.zh: 要是她知道就好了。

lines.en: : Uh...Sana’s mom? Can we-
lines.zh: : 呃……Sana 的妈妈？我们能——

lines.en: : Stop calling me that! Just Sara is fine. Or Mom! Or Mama. Or Mommy.
lines.zh: : 别那么叫我！叫 Sara 就行。或者妈妈！或者妈咪。或者妈妈桑。

lines.en: : Actually, no. Mommy might be kind of weird. But the others are-
lines.zh: : 其实不行。妈妈桑可能有点怪。不过其他几个——

lines.en: : {i}Sara...{/i}do we really need to do this now? I’m...okay with spending time with you, of course. But right now, I want to-
lines.zh: : {i}Sara……{/i}我们真的非得现在搞这个吗？我……当然愿意和你相处。但现在，我想——

lines.en: : Shh! It’s fine! We can get to know each other a little better while your uncle explains the different types of motherly energy to Yuki — a woman who, despite being a mother, is unfamiliar with all of them.
lines.zh: : 嘘！没事的！你们可以趁你舅舅向 Yuki 解释不同类型的母性能量时多了解彼此一点——而 Yuki 这个女人，尽管自己也是个母亲，却对其中任何一种都不熟悉。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive12
: You really gonna throw shade at me all casually like that? I’ve barely even said shit.
lines.zh: : 你真要这么随随便便地阴阳我？我他妈几乎还没说话呢。

lines.en: : Is there a reason you want to go for a walk? Because, if not, I kind of want to stay here and make sure Sara doesn’t force Ami to sign any adoption papers.
lines.zh: : 你想去散步是有原因的吗？因为如果没有，我还挺想留在这儿，确保 Sara 不会逼 Ami 签什么收养文件。

lines.en: : Now just sign here and-
lines.zh: : 现在只要在这儿签个字——

lines.en: : Yoink.
lines.zh: : 缴获。

lines.en: : Noooo! My newest daughter!
lines.zh: : 不要啊！我最新的女儿！

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive13
: There’s somethin’ I wanna talk about, but I ain’t good at doin’ that shit in front of other people. Shouldn’t take long, though. You can get right back to chaperoning your niece in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 有件事我想聊聊，但我不擅长在别人面前搞那套。不过不会太久。几分钟后你就可以回来当你的侄女监护人了。

lines.en: : Then, I guess it can’t be helped.
lines.zh: : 那看来是没办法了。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll be right back, Ami. Just humor Sara for now.
lines.zh: : 我马上回来，Ami。先顺着 Sara 一会儿。

lines.en: : If...that’s what you think is best...
lines.zh: : 如果……你觉得这样最好的话……

lines.en: Yuki leads me into the woods and given that she is much stronger and more intimidating than me, I can’t help but trick myself into thinking I’m about to be mugged for everything I’ve got.
lines.zh: Yuki 领着我走进树林，而鉴于她比我强壮得多、也更有压迫感，我忍不住骗自己说，我马上就要被抢光身上所有的东西了。

lines.en: Which isn’t much, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，那也没多少。

lines.en: But she could probably fetch a pretty penny for auctioning off my niece to some underground organization specializing in human trafficking or the selective breeding of redheads.
lines.zh: 不过要是把我侄女拍卖给某个专门从事人口贩卖、或者红发选择性育种的地下组织，她说不定能卖个好价钱。

lines.en: I doubt Sara would be in on that, though. She seems to like young girls a little too much to try shipping any of them off.
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑 Sara 不会参与那种事。她似乎太喜欢年轻女孩了，不会把她们中的任何一个送走。

lines.en: Which kind of sucks for Haruka if you think about it. Because she likes them a lot too, but in a completely different way.
lines.zh: 仔细想想，这对 Haruka 来说还挺惨的。因为她也非常喜欢她们，只是方式完全不同。

lines.en: So yeah, that’s what I’m thinking about as we move further into the woods.
lines.zh: 所以，是的，当我们往树林深处走时，我想的就是这些。
: 那个……

lines.en: But, of course, Yuki is thinking about something completely different.
lines.zh: 不过，当然，Yuki 想的完全是另一回事。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive14
: Sara tells me you’re lookin’ to be like more of a dad to Ami or some shit?
lines.zh: : Sara 跟我说，你想当个更像父亲的人给 Ami 看什么的？

lines.en: : Do secrets just not exist to women or something?
lines.zh: : 秘密这种东西对女人来说是不存在的吗？

lines.en: : That shit don’t exist to anybody, man. Sure you’d be gossipin’ with your guy friends too if you weren’t a creep who only hung out with people who have vaginas.
lines.zh: : 这种东西对任何人都不存在，老兄。你要不是个只和有阴道的人混在一起的变态，你肯定也跟你那帮哥们聊八卦。

lines.en: : Well, forgive me but my options are pretty limited in a city where men basically just don’t exist.
lines.zh: : 那请原谅我，毕竟在一座男人基本不存在的城市里，我的选择相当有限。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive15
: You’re right, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你说得对。

lines.en: : I doubt much would change even if they did.
lines.zh: : 就算男人存在，我怀疑也不会有多大改变。

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ wrong with sharin’ secrets so long as it gets more people on your side, I think. And Sara only told me to begin with since I’m goin’ through the same shit with Yumi right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得只要能拉更多人站到你这边，分享秘密也没什么不好。而且 Sara 之所以会告诉我，本来就是因为我现在正和 Yumi 经历同样的事。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive16
: You are?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Tryin’ to, at least. But it ain’t exactly easy when I’ve been even more absent than you’ve been for the entire time you’ve known Ami.
lines.zh: : 对。至少在试着。不过这并不容易，毕竟从你认识 Ami 起，我缺席的时间比你还要长得多。

lines.en: : Which means you’ve still got the benefit of havin’ her like you and that’s a thing I ain’t ever had. But I also get that shit’s probably a little more confusing on account of you not bein’ her actual {i}dad{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: : 这意味着你至少还占着「她喜欢你」这个便宜，而这东西我从来就没有过。不过我也理解，因为你本来就不是她的亲生{i}父亲{/i}，这事大概会更让人糊涂一些。

lines.en: : So that’s why you wanted to go for a walk? Are we going to give each other tips on how to be bad parents?
lines.zh: : 所以你想散步就是为了这个？我们要互相传授怎么当糟糕父母的诀窍吗？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive17
: That ain’t it, man. Just want you to know that I understand what you’re goin’ through and that it’s totally fine if all of this makes you feel like shit.
lines.zh: : 不是，老兄。我只是想让你知道，我理解你正在经历什么，而且如果这一切让你觉得自己是坨屎，那完全正常。

lines.en: : Knowin’ you failed somebody you could have turned into a great person stings. And it sucks extra hard because that shit just hits you outta nowhere sometimes.
lines.zh: : 知道自己辜负了一个本可以被你培养成很棒的人，会很痛。而且这事儿最操蛋的地方在于，它有时候会毫无预兆地砸到你头上。

lines.en: : Like, I ain’t gonna lie, there were long periods where I forgot I even {i}had{/i} a daughter. But bein’ around her again has been makin’ me realize just how fuckin’ dumb I was to not, like...keep her in my thoughts, you know?
lines.zh: : 比如，说实话，我曾经有很长一段时间忘了我还{i}有{/i}个女儿。可重新和她待在一起之后，我开始意识到自己当年有多他妈蠢——居然没有，怎么说……把她放在心上，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Do you love her?
lines.zh: : 你爱她吗？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive18
: {i}Love,{/i} huh?
: Yeah.
: Do you love Ami?
lines.zh: : 你爱 Ami 吗？

lines.en: : I do.
: How do you know that? Like...what’s different about the way you look at her than you would look at somebody like Sara or...any of your other friends I don’t know shit about?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道的？比如……你看她的眼神，和你看着 Sara 或者……我压根不认识的你的其他任何一个朋友时，有什么不同？

lines.en: : I think it comes down to how much pain you’re willing to withstand to prevent that person from going through the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我觉得归根结底，是为了不让那个人经历同样的事，你愿意承受多少痛苦。

lines.en: : Does it really work that way?
lines.zh: : 真的能这么算吗？

lines.en: : No. But I still think that’s a good way to measure it. So, if you’d be willing to hurt yourself in exchange for Yumi’s continued “happiness,” I don’t think it’s crazy to say you love her.
lines.zh: : 不能。不过我依然觉得这是个不错的衡量方式。所以，如果你愿意为了 Yumi 持续的「幸福」而伤害自己，那我觉得说你爱她并不疯狂。

lines.en: : See, that’s where shit gets hard though, isn’t it? Because you and me don’t really give a fuck about ourselves.
lines.zh: : 你看，难点就在这儿了，不是吗？因为你和我其实都不他妈在乎自己。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive19

: But at least you’re healthy and shit. I’ll be lucky to get another ten years outta life with how much smoking and drinking I do. And that ain’t even countin’ all the doping I did the last couple decades.
lines.zh: : 但至少你还健康什么的。就我这抽烟喝酒的量，能再活十年都算走运。这还没算上过去二十年我灌进去的那些药。

lines.en: : So yeah, I’d be fine with gettin’ hurt if it’d prevent Yumi from feelin’ that shit. But I’d probably do the same thing for you as well and I sure as fuck don’t love {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以是啊，如果能不让 Yumi 感受那些东西，我受伤也无所谓。不过换作是你，我大概也会这么做，而我他妈肯定不爱{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Maybe you do?
lines.zh: : 说不定你爱呢？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive20
: That boyfriend joke from earlier go to your head or something?
lines.zh: : 刚才那个男友玩笑让你飘了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Maybe. Or maybe I just liked the idea of being a real family and want to hear your daughter call me Daddy?
lines.zh: : 也许。或者也许我只是喜欢「组成一个真正的家庭」这个念头，还想听你女儿叫我 Daddy？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive21
: I’m just gonna go ahead and pretend you meant that in the less creepy way.
lines.zh: : 我就当你是用比较不恶心的方式说的吧。

lines.en: : You took that better than I thought, so maybe you don’t love her after all?
lines.zh: : 你接受得比我想象中好，所以也许你终究并不爱她？

lines.en: : Maybe I do, maybe I don’t. Shit’s complicated. Can’t really make sense of how I actually feel.
lines.zh: : 也许爱，也许不爱。这破事很复杂。我真搞不清自己到底是什么感觉。

lines.en: : But I’ve been seein’ her more often lately...
lines.zh: : 不过我最近见她见得比较多……

lines.en: : I buy extra shit for her when I go to the store now.
lines.zh: : 现在去商店会多买点东西给她。

lines.en: : Even text her to see if she wants to get dinner or some shit a few nights outta the week. And, you know...sometimes she does. And I like that.
lines.zh: : 甚至一周里有几个晚上会发短信问她要不要一起吃晚饭什么的。而且，你知道……有时候她会来。我喜欢那样。

lines.en: : But it feels fuckin’ weird because, like...{i}why?{/i} Why’s she still showin’ me kindness like that after all the shit I put her through? Cause if my parents pulled that shit with me, ain’t no way I’d crash on their couch.
lines.zh: : 可这感觉他妈很怪，因为，比如……{i}为什么{/i}？在我让她受了那么多苦之后，她为什么还对我那么好？因为要是我父母对我干那种事，我绝不可能去睡他们的沙发。

lines.en: : Probably because {i}she{/i} loves {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 大概是因为{i}她{/i}爱{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Yumi doesn’t love me. She’s smarter than that.
lines.zh: : Yumi 不爱我。她没那么傻。

lines.en: : Love isn’t really something you can apply logic to, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 爱这种东西，是不太能拿逻辑去套的，Yuki。

lines.en: : You think?
lines.zh: : 你这么觉得？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive22
: Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : I’m also kind of in the dark when it comes to that.
lines.zh: : 在这件事上我也挺摸黑的。

lines.en: : But right now, what matters most to me is making sure that Ami doesn’t wind up feeling like this one day. And I think you’re doing a good job of doing that same thing for Yumi.
lines.zh: : 不过现在对我来说最重要的，是确保 Ami 将来不会有一天也有这种感觉。而我觉得你在为 Yumi 做同样的事，做得很好。

lines.en: : Truth be told, I think we’re doin’ pretty shitty jobs when push comes to shove. But in a race, it ain’t how ya start that matters, it’s how ya finish. And there ain’t no way that growin’ up isn’t a race.
lines.zh: : 说实话，真到紧要关头，我觉得我们俩都干得挺操蛋的。不过比赛嘛，重要的不是怎么起跑，而是怎么冲线。而成长不可能不是一场比赛。

lines.en: : Blink once and a year goes by. Blink twice and suddenly it’s harder to breathe. Blink a third time and you’re five inches shorter.
lines.zh: : 眨一次眼，一年就过去了。眨两次眼，突然就呼吸困难了。眨第三次眼，你就矮了五英寸。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive23
: Life goes by too fuckin’ fast, man. And we’re terrible people for forcin’ those girls to go through it.
lines.zh: : 人生过得他妈太快了，老兄。而我们逼着那些女孩去经历它，真是糟糕的人。

lines.en: : Technically speaking, I’ve never brought anyone into this world. So I’m not {i}forcing{/i} anyone to do anything.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我从没把任何人带到这个世界上。所以我没有{i}逼{/i}任何人做任何事。

lines.en: : But I’m not helping either. And that’s what this trip is about.
lines.zh: : 但我也没在帮忙。而这正是这趟旅行的意义。

lines.en: : I feel you there. I tried inviting Yumi but, of course, she had other shit going on.
lines.zh: : 这我懂。我试着邀请 Yumi 了，不过她当然有别的事。

lines.en: : She has a job now. Did you know that?
lines.zh: : 她现在有工作了。你知道吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I ran into her the other night when I was about to jump off a bridge.
lines.zh: : 知道。前几天晚上我正要跳桥的时候撞见她了。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive24
: She save you?
lines.zh: : 她救了你？

lines.en: : In a way, maybe.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上，也许吧。

lines.en: : That’s my girl.
lines.zh: : 不愧是我的女儿。

lines.en: : You could show a little more concern for {i}me{/i} you know.
lines.zh: : 你也可以对{i}我{/i}多表示点关心啊。

lines.en: : You really think I’ve got the emotional capacity to worry about more than one person?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我有那个情绪容量去担心不止一个人吗？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive25
: Just thinkin’ about Yumi’s hard enough to-
lines.zh: : 光是想想 Yumi 就已经够——

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive26
: Woah, what the fuck? Is that Kaori over there?
lines.zh: : 哇，什么鬼？那边那个是 Kaori 吗？

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive27
: That...is Kaori. Yes.
lines.zh: : 那是……Kaori。是的。

lines.en: : Did she...kidnap somebody?
lines.zh: : 她……绑架了什么人？

lines.en: : Technically? Yes. But it’s a little more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 严格来说？是的。不过事情比那要复杂一点。

lines.en: scene black
: Yo! Kaori!
lines.zh: : 喂！Kaori！

lines.en: : Who goes to the place where we are located?! Stand back or face the wrath of my liquid pepper!
lines.zh: : 是谁来到了我们所处的位置？！退后，否则就面对我的液体胡椒之怒！

lines.en: : Wait...Aunt Yukiburger? And uncle Friendburgerhamfriendburgerman?!
lines.zh: : 等等……Yukiburger 阿姨？还有 Friendburgerhamfriendburgerman 叔叔？！

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive28
: Why are the three minus one of you spending your unday with an S inside the town where trees live?
lines.zh: : 你们这三减一个人，为什么要在树木居住的城镇里度过那个前面带 S 的 unday？

lines.en: : Same question goes to you, yo. The fuck you doin’ out here in the woods with a kid?
lines.zh: : 同样的问题还给你，哟。你他妈带着个孩子在树林里干什么？

lines.en: : Hello, Nao. Cool frog.
lines.zh: : 你好，Nao。酷青蛙。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive29
: This is no childburger, it is Nao-chan. And I am her mothermom, which makes you her motheraunt.
lines.zh: : 这不是小孩堡，这是 Nao-chan。而我是她的妈妈妈，也就是说你是她的妈妈姨。

lines.en: : It makes me what?
lines.zh: : 这让我成了什么？

lines.en: : Motherauntmomburgermomyuki.
lines.zh: : 妈妈姨妈妈堡妈妈Yuki。

lines.en: : Nao doesn’t speak. And if you feel a strange, otherworldly presence emanating from her, you are not alone for I, too, feel that way.
lines.zh: : Nao 不说话。而如果你感觉到有什么奇怪的、不属于这个世界的气息从她身上散发出来，你并不孤单，因为我也感觉到了。

lines.en: : So Kaori kidnapped a mute kid and dragged her into the woods so she could play with a frog? Aight.
lines.zh: : 所以 Kaori 绑架了一个不会说话的小孩，把她拖进树林，好让她和一只青蛙玩？行吧。

lines.en: : Frog Boy is a living day-of-birth present. The reason we are in the same location as you is for a special human treasure hunt.
lines.zh: : 蛙仔是一只活着的出生日礼物。我们之所以和你们在同一个位置，是为了一场特别的人类寻宝。

lines.en: : Treasure hunt?
lines.zh: : 寻宝？

lines.en: : It is what humans call the act of hunting for treasure.
lines.zh: : 这就是人类对寻找宝藏这一行为的称呼。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive30
: Friend! Surely you remember the last flattened tree corpse that sent us on a similar hunt! Do you shoelaces?!
lines.zh: : 朋友！你肯定还记得上一次那具把我们送上类似狩猎的、被压平的树木尸体吧！你鞋带吗？！

lines.en: : Was that supposed to mean “do you not?”
lines.zh: : 那应该是想说「你不」吧？

lines.en: : I think it’d be “knot” technically.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我觉得应该是「结」。

lines.en: : Thanks for the added clarity, Yuki. Conveying audio-based jokes through text boxes is hard.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你补充的清晰说明，Yuki。用文本框传达基于语音的笑话真难。

lines.en: : So you don’t shoelaces! Just as I presumed!
lines.zh: : 那你就是鞋带了！和我猜想的一样！

lines.en: : Are you saying you got another treasure map? And that you brought Nao here to help you investigate?
lines.zh: : 你是说你又拿到一张藏宝图了？而且你带 Nao 来是帮你一起调查？

lines.en: : Nao-chan is correct!
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 说得对！

lines.en: : But she didn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 可她什么都没说。

lines.en: : Her mouth words do not matter when her heart words are much louder! But either which way, I am excited to greet you on this day, Friend and Auntfriend!
lines.zh: : 当她心里的话更响亮时，她嘴上的话就不重要了！不过不管怎样，我很高兴在这一天与你们相会，朋友和阿姨朋友！

lines.en: : Treasure is easier to find when the amount of hand-arms reaching for it increases.
lines.zh: : 够到宝藏的手臂越多，宝藏就越容易找到。

lines.en: scene yukicamparrive31
: Well, you have fun with that. I’m gonna go celebrate being out in the wilderness by day drinking until I have a migraine.
lines.zh: : 行，你们玩得开心。我要去用大白天喝酒来庆祝身处荒野，直到喝出偏头痛。

lines.en: : Aunt Yukiburger?
lines.zh: : Yukiburger 阿姨？

lines.en: : I think she just wants to relax today. But I’ll try and find the time to help you with your treasure hunt if I’m able to.
lines.zh: : 我想她今天只是想放松一下。不过如果有时间，我会试着帮你寻宝的。

lines.en: scene sky
: Excellence!
lines.zh: : 极好！

lines.en: : Nao-chan and I have to make nine minus three more preparations first, but we will await your un-departed departure as soon as you are shoelaces-shoelaces ready!
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 和我还要先做九减三个准备，不过一旦你们鞋带鞋带地准备好了，我们就会恭候你们尚未离开的离开！

lines.en: : In the angry-time...come, Nao-chan! I will show you the correct way to search for felinefish!
lines.zh: : 在那个愤怒的时间……来吧，Nao-chan！我来教你怎么正确地寻找猫鱼！

lines.en: Nao excitedly hurries after her “mothermom” and the two of them disappear inside of a tent that...I’m surprised they were able to set up without the help of an actual adult rather than whatever Kaori is.
lines.zh: Nao 兴奋地追在她的「妈妈妈」身后，两人消失在一顶帐篷里——而我很惊讶她们居然能在没有真正成年人（而不是 Kaori 那种东西）帮忙的情况下把帐篷搭起来。

lines.en: Either way, I should probably take a page out of Yuki’s book and attempt to relax as well if Sara is going to be keeping Ami occupied for the time being.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，既然 Sara 暂时会占着 Ami，我大概也该学学 Yuki 的样子，试着放松一下。

lines.en: I just hope that things are going well.
lines.zh: 我只希望一切顺利。

lines.en: I’m worried enough about her as-is and the last thing I need is today making things even harder than they’ve been lately.
lines.zh: 我为她操的心已经够多了，我最不需要的，就是今天让事情变得比最近更难。

lines.en: I just want her to get back to normal or...something that resembles it.
lines.zh: 我只想让她恢复正常，或者……接近正常的东西。

lines.en: Which means I need to do the same.
lines.zh: 这意味着我也得这么做。

lines.en: But that also means I have to figure out how to spend the next hour or two. That being said...
lines.zh: 但那也意味着我得想清楚接下来这一两个小时怎么过。话虽如此……

lines.en: What do I want to do?
lines.zh: 我想做什么？
